description: Use this to register interest in a property FOR SALE with the agent (Kaufinteresse anmelden, kaufen möchten, intérêt d'achat, interesse all'acquisto). Optional: phone, a message and the financing status (unknown, self_funded, confirmed, approved). Call it directly once they confirm – if they are not signed in, the app shows the Heimster sign-in itself.

language.description: Language of titles, descriptions and links (default de). Use the user's language.
